actives_below_50.how: sample (SPL) wells whose NormLum is below 50 %; nearest value to the cut-off 0.379 % away

z_prime.how: 1 - 3 (SD POSCON + SD NEGCON) / |mean POSCON - mean NEGCON| with sample SDs
z_prime.reader: Gen5 LUM reads and layout, plain arithmetic

z_prime_population_sd.reader: Gen5 LUM reads and layout, plain arithmetic

uv_area_300_350.how: trapezoid of absorbance over 300-350 nm (no baseline)

uv_area_300_350_spread.how: largest relative distance of a way from their mean

carbonate_band_area.how: trapezoid of absorbance over 1300-1550 cm-1 above the straight line between the band limits; SpectroChemPy and OMNIC's CSV export, samples inside or ends interpolated

carbonate_band_area_spread.how: largest relative distance of a way from their mean (the tolerance covers twice it)

aromaticity_index.how: area 1535-1670 over area 1350-1525 cm-1, each above its local straight baseline; samples inside or ends interpolated

aromaticity_index_spread.how: largest relative distance of a way from their mean

largest_ch_stretch_treatment.how: trapezoid 2800-3000 cm-1 above the straight line between the band limits per spectrum, the sheet's treatment of the largest

band_max_in_window_cm1.how: Raman shift of the highest point between 1550 and 1650 cm-1

raman_step_cm1.how: median spacing of the Raman-shift list
